title: Things nobody tells you about Buffalo Bayou
why: Houston locals who've seen the bayou from a car; specific, checkable details (founding site, official city bird, key hold, refund policy) make them want to see it from water level.
hook_options: Buffalo Bayou isn't what you drove past
You launch where Houston started. And six more things.
The city has an official bird. It lives here.
caption: You launch at Allen's Landing, where Houston was founded in 1836. The city's official bird fishes the banks. There's no current to fight. Staff hold your keys. And the traffic noise just stops. A few things locals miss about their own bayou. #buffalobayou #houstonhistory #urbannature #buffalobayoukayak

slides.headline: Buffalo Bayou isn't what you drove past
slides.body: From the freeway it's a blur. From water level it's a different city. A few things locals miss.

slides.headline: You launch where Houston started
slides.body: Allen's Landing is where the city was founded in 1836. Your kayak goes in at the original port.

slides.headline: The city has an official bird. It lives here.
slides.body: One guest was "blown away" by the herons, egrets and the city's official bird, the yellow-crowned night heron.

slides.headline: There's no current to fight
slides.body: The bayou is slow water. Head upstream toward Waugh or work the downtown stretch and still make it back easy.

slides.headline: Look small, too
slides.body: Herons get the attention. Guides also turn up guys like this one. Wildlife is common, never guaranteed.

slides.headline: Staff will hold your car keys
slides.body: No pockets, no problem. Hand your keys over at check-in and leave valuables in the car.

slides.headline: The banks bloom at water level
slides.body: Wildflowers along the bank, inches above the bayou. You only notice them at kayak speed.

slides.headline: Rain? Refund or reschedule. Your call.
slides.body: If we call it for weather, full refund. Cancel 24 hours or more ahead, full refund too.

slides.headline: Paddlers clean this bayou
slides.body: Buffalo Bayou Kayak runs community cleanups on the water. Want to help beautify the bayou? Ask about the next one.

slides.kicker: Save this. Send it to a Houstonian.
slides.headline: Your city looks different from down here
slides.body: Kayak tours and rentals from Allen's Landing. Book at buffalobayoukayak.com.
